scenario: 勒索软件通过永恒之蓝和 PsExec 横向传播

judgment.summary: Active ransomware outbreak confirmed on critical production assets. Initial compromise via MS17-010 exploitation followed by PsExec lateral movement resulting in file encryption on 3 servers.
evidence_chain: EDR detected Encryptor.exe execution and .crypt file extension on 10.0.1.45, 10.0.1.46, 10.0.1.47 (source: query_alert_detail)
Asset 10.0.1.45 identified as critical production server 'Order Processing System' in production zone (source: query_asset_info)
File hash c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9 flagged as ransomware/worm exploiting MS17-010 (source: query_threat_intel)
Related alerts confirm MS17-010 exploit from 192.0.2.60, PsExec lateral movement to other hosts, and C2 beacon to 198.51.100.250 (source: query_related_alerts)

iocs.context: Ransomware payload hash associated with worm capability

remediation: Immediately isolate affected hosts (10.0.1.45, 10.0.1.46, 10.0.1.47) from the network to prevent further lateral movement.
Block outbound traffic to C2 IP 198.51.100.250 and inbound from 192.0.2.60 at perimeter firewall and EDR policies.
Apply MS17-010 patch on all Windows systems and disable SMBv1 if not required to close initial vulnerability.
Reset local administrator passwords and service account credentials used by PsExec across the domain to stop credential-based spread.
Initiate forensic investigation and restore data from clean backups after ensuring environment is sanitized.
